prometheus_stopped.body:
# HELP eclipse_up 1 while the game runs and answers
# TYPE eclipse_up gauge
eclipse_up 0
# HELP eclipse_supervisor_uptime_seconds Seconds since eclipse-server started
# TYPE eclipse_supervisor_uptime_seconds gauge
eclipse_supervisor_uptime_seconds <dynamic>
# HELP eclipse_crashes Game crashes since eclipse-server started
# TYPE eclipse_crashes gauge
eclipse_crashes 2
# HELP eclipse_tps Ticks per second over the last 5 seconds
# TYPE eclipse_tps gauge
eclipse_tps 19.9
# HELP eclipse_tps_target The tick rate the game aims for (/tick rate)
# TYPE eclipse_tps_target gauge
eclipse_tps_target 20
# HELP eclipse_mspt Milliseconds per tick: the average and the percentiles /tick query reports
# TYPE eclipse_mspt gauge
eclipse_mspt{stat="average"} 8.25
eclipse_mspt{stat="p50"} 7
eclipse_mspt{stat="p95"} 12.5
eclipse_mspt{stat="p99"} 18
# HELP eclipse_players_online Players online
# TYPE eclipse_players_online gauge
eclipse_players_online 2
# HELP eclipse_players_max max-players
# TYPE eclipse_players_max gauge
eclipse_players_max 20
# HELP eclipse_chunks_loaded Chunks loaded
# TYPE eclipse_chunks_loaded gauge
eclipse_chunks_loaded 321
# HELP eclipse_memory_rss_bytes The game process's resident memory
# TYPE eclipse_memory_rss_bytes gauge
eclipse_memory_rss_bytes 536870912
# HELP eclipse_cpu_percent The game process's CPU use (100 = one core)
# TYPE eclipse_cpu_percent gauge
eclipse_cpu_percent 12.5
